about: ONE global weight table (Q4). score = sum over a part's CODMunity stat deltas of dir x weight[profile] x value. 'close' favours ADS speed, sprint-to-fire and movement (Q3); 'range' favours range and recoil. No per-gun weights. Tuned once on 2026-11-17 (see reports/build-variants-report.md for before/after pass counts); never tuned to make a specific gun pass.

evidence.ADS Speed / ADS Out Speed / Sprint To Fi: CODMunity attachment table, 2026-11-17: 'No Stock' shows ADS Speed -17, Sprint To Fire -7 together with Movement +4, ADS Movement +15 and Recoil +30 (the fast, wobbly choice); '60 Round Drum' shows ADS Speed +8 with Movement -2 and Sprint -3 (the heavy, slow choice); '11.5 Shortline Barrel' shows ADS Speed -9 with Movement +4 and Recoil +8.
evidence.Movement / Sprint / Strafe Speed / ADS M: same rows: heavier parts show negative values (45 Round Mag Movement -1, 60 Round Drum -2), light parts positive.
evidence.Recoil / Gun Kick / Idle Sway / Gun Bob: FSS Fireline Grip: Recoil -8 and Gun Kick -8 (the stabilising grip); PF1 Fixed Stock Recoil -8.
evidence.Range / Bullet Velocity / Magazine Size: 18 LE Crosswind Range +15; 5.56 NATO High Velocity Bullet Velocity +20.
evidence.Reload Speed is a time, lower is better: 60 Round Drum Reload Speed +26 and 45 Round Mag +15 on larger magazines.
